Policy areas and research coverage

Policy areas are research categories. Their presence does not assert that any jurisdiction regulates the area or that a legal obligation exists.

A domain status aggregates recorded evidence across the listed jurisdictions. Candidate source leads have not been captured, verified or interpreted.
